stem.text: $\text{HOCl(aq)}$ is the molecule that kills bacteria when chlorine is added to water.
The following reaction produces this molecule.
Which statement about this reaction is correct?

A.text: Chlorine is both oxidised and reduced.

B.text: Chlorine is oxidised but not reduced.

C.text: Hydrogen is both oxidised and reduced.

D.text: Hydrogen is oxidised but not reduced.
